localeEvidence: Active legacy Cyberpunk beta scope is normalized as EN by the pinned Locale Core contract. Raw legacy runtime records omit locale; no FR reference is inferred or introduced.

steps: For Gear, Legend, Program and Unit, choose shortest and longest rulesText, tie-break cardId.
Choose the darkest remaining Red and Blue representatives and brightest remaining Yellow and Green representatives by central-image luminance.
Choose the closest cross-card pair among remaining representatives by RGB proxy MSE.
Choose the remaining card with the largest active printing group, tie-break cardId.
selectionMethod.representative: For each card select a standard active printing first, then printingId lexical order. This never substitutes a retail edition outside the active beta scope.

imageAnalysis.source: Unmodified active source Vision WEBP assets; SHA-256 checked for all 229 profiles.
imageAnalysis.decode: Chromium canvas image decode; no product code or matcher changes.
imageAnalysis.luminance: Mean (0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B) / 255 in the measured window.
imageAnalysis.similarity: Mean squared difference over RGB values scaled to [0,1] in the same window; a selection proxy only, not a Vision matcher score.
imageAnalysis.limitations: The fixed central-image window is an illustration proxy, not a manually segmented artwork mask. Frame/color labels and text lengths come directly from source records. Physical lighting, glare and recognition performance are unknown.

matrix.instructions: Normal room light, readable card mainly facing the camera, realistic playing distance, ordinary play table. Start each trial before presenting the card; return to an empty scene before the next trial.
Use two realistic tabletop angles, with an operator description; no geometric angle measurement required.
Lower room lighting that remains playable. Keep nominal distance and position; record an approximate non-sensitive lighting description.
Compare nearby realistic play distances with the same normal lighting. Record an approximate distance description; no search for a theoretical maximum.
Compare slight in-plane rotation with the upright nominal control. Strong rotation is optional and separately labelled.

matrix.unavailablePolicy: Record NOT_TESTED and the absence of an actual game sleeve, never an inferred sleeve PASS.
matrix.instructions: Only use a real game sleeve if available. Describe visible reflections and compare with the matching nominal case.
After presentation keep the same card continuously visible for ten seconds. Count true identity transitions and intervals without identification; no physical stability claim from fixtures.

Present until identified, mark removal immediately before physically removing the card, then measure until no identity is visible. If never identified, record the failed precondition and an invalid removal observation.
Present A, mark removal and remove A, then start a new trial and present B. Measure clearance of A and first stable correct B separately; preserve the linked trial IDs.

matrix.instructions: Present each printing separately in the same nominal setup. Do not treat similarity-proxy rankings as physical test results. Report canonical correctness and physical-printing resolution separately.

trialPolicy.note: A protocol observation window, not an engine latency threshold or an automatic product failure. Use the same window for comparisons and report early stops as invalid.

plan.substitutionPolicy: Record actual physical availability and every substitution before trials. This prepared plan recommends 15 distinct canonical cards and three trials each (45 nominal trials). Any adjusted 12-15-card plan requires a documented protocol revision before trials, preserving intended diversity; never remove failed trials retroactively. Keep the same measured profile and active 229 EN scope; availability gaps remain explicit.
plan.privacy: Store results and non-sensitive categorical setup metadata only. No webcam video, screenshots, faces, audio, SDP, ICE candidates or raw device IDs. Free notes must be manually checked for privacy before export.
